title: Delicate HUD controls
brief: Replace heavy pixel controls with delicate terminal-feasible alternatives that harmonize with the sidebar.

artboards.title: Fine lines
artboards.tradeoff: Light two-row line art, no icon font required; microphone needs validation at actual terminal size.

artboards.title: Compact symbols
artboards.tradeoff: Quiet single-row controls; headphone and microphone symbols depend on terminal font coverage.

artboards.title: Quiet labels
artboards.tradeoff: Maximum legibility and predictable font support, trading pictograms for short action labels.
